description: Ask to invite someone to the team. The account owner must confirm the invitation on the website before anything happens: until then no invitation is sent and no seat is used. The owner sees the request on the website and is normally notified by email. Asking again for the same address returns the open request. Only the account owner's API keys and connected apps can ask, while the plan includes team seats.
name: invite_team_member

detail.description: Plain English to pass on to the person behind the request.
